enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down slightly. Turn to right side. Curl up.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stretch arms overhead. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Cup hands under water. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Place on counter. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Take out bowl from cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put phone in bag. Close bag. Pick up keys. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at phone. Check time. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone again. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Type reply. Pick up phone. Answer call. Speak into phone. Hang up. Open document. Type report. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printout. Walk back to desk. Sit down. File papers. Open drawer. Put files in drawer. Close drawer.

Stand up from desk. Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Use restroom. Wash hands. Dry hands. Walk back to desk. Sit down.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Type notes. Attend meeting. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Sit in chair. Listen to speaker. Take notes. Ask question. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Write prescription. Make phone call. Talk to patient. Stand up. Walk to examination room. Check patient. Return to desk.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables in pan. Stir with spatula. Add meat. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat with fork and knife.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop on show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Type comment. Put phone down. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body.

Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Curl up.
